stock.description: Great Wall Terroir Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides telecommunication and related services principally in Hong Kong, Singapore, and the People's Republic of China. It operates through Telecommunication Services, IT Business, and Property Investment segments. It offers broadband connectivity solutions; information technology related services and solutions; voice and data services and solutions to business organizations and residential customers; and GPS services, as well as provides e-commerce business. The company was formerly known as Great Wall Belt & Road Holdings Limited and changed its name to Great Wall Terroir Holdings Limited in June 2021. Great Wall Terroir Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
